resources.string: In Desktop Mode, BentoBar dynamically adjusts to fit within the top bar of floating windows alongside the icon and name of the app, and the minimize, close, and, maximize buttons whenever it would obstruct them. This is to be used when the system hides or disables the status bar at the top of the screen in its desktop windowing mode.
Keep clear at a window\'s left
Keep clear at a window\'s right
Where this item goes while Desktop Mode is active, so it can show or hide along with the status bar.

BentoBar stays where its alignment puts it and lies over a window\'s icon and name when they are there. It never covers the window\'s buttons. Off: it moves aside to keep clear of the icon and name too.
Distance from the top in Desktop Mode

Desktop Mode has a layout of its own: what you put in each card here, and each item\'s settings, apply only while it is active. Items are ordered as in the regular bar, and an item that is Same as usual follows that bar\'s card.

While a window is maximized it has no title bar of the system\'s to sit in, and an app\'s own top bar would lie under BentoBar. BentoBar then shows only a running timer or a meeting about to start, plus ‹, as in Presenting mode, and comes back when the window is smaller.
Off: Desktop Mode looks like the regular bar. On: it has its own alignment, distance from the top and place for each item (the Bar page then shows a Desktop Mode view).
Where ‹ stands when the bar is in the middle
Pressing ‹ puts each hidden item where it sits in the layout, among the others, instead of unfolding them all on the side ‹ is on.
The wheel over the volume or Now playing item changes its level or place. Off: only a click or a drag does.
Items with a Show when… rule sit where they will pop in.
A click on the volume, brightness or Now playing slider sets nothing: it moves only when you drag it.
While the screen is upright (taller than wide), BentoBar shows only a running timer or a meeting about to start, plus ‹, as in Presenting mode.
Spacers\' divider lines show only after ‹ is pressed and the hidden items are out.
